description: Source code for diff generation and comparison of block versions in a notification system, including classes for representing diffs, properties, schemas, and a diff generator with methods to produce diffs based on block history.

classes.name: Diff
classes.description: Represents differences between two versions of a block, including references to the board, card, authors, block type, old and new block states, update timestamp, schema diffs, property diffs, and child diffs.

classes.name: PropDiff
classes.description: Represents a change in a property, including property ID, index, name, old value, and new value.

classes.name: SchemaDiff
classes.description: Represents a difference in property definitions between two schemas, including references to the board, old property definition, and new property definition.

classes.name: diffGenerator
classes.description: A struct responsible for generating diffs between block versions, holding references to the board, card, data store, notification hint, last notification timestamp, and logger.

methods.name: generateDiffs
methods.description: Generates diffs for the current block based on its history, returning a list of diffs or an error.

methods.name: generateDiffsForCard
methods.description: Generates diffs for a card block, including its child blocks, returning a diff or an error.

methods.name: generateDiffForBlock
methods.description: Generates a diff for a specific block, comparing its current state with its previous version.

methods.name: generatePropDiffs
methods.description: Compares properties of old and new blocks to identify added, changed, or deleted properties, returning a sorted list of property diffs.

methods.name: sortPropDiffs
methods.description: Sorts a list of property diffs based on their index.
